raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview Part 2 of #42449: `KVCacheSpec` now describes only a layer's **tensor layout**. **Allocation policy** (windows, recycling, prefix caching, Mamba modes) moves onto the KV cache manager that enforces it. Layers declare `(manager_cls, manager_config, spec)`, and a group is simply *layers that share a block table*. **Draft:** CPU unit tests only so far; GPU and E2E validation pending. ## The payoff: no more `UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs` | | Before | After | |---|---|---| | Spec classes | 15 (8 encode only policy) | 5 layout classes: `AttentionSpec`, `MLAAttentionSpec`, `HiddenStateCacheSpec`, `MambaSpec`, `HiSparsePageSpec` | | Policy | spec fields + subclasses | `Manager.Config`, e.g. `SlidingWindowManager.Config(sliding_window, ...)` | | Spec → manager | global `KVCacheSpecRegistry` + platform hook | the layer names its manager: `SlidingWindowManager.layer_config(spec, sliding_window=w)` | | Mixed-layout groups | `UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs` wrapper | `group.kv_cache_specs[layer]` | | Sizing | per-spec methods + wrapper aggregation | `manager.max_blocks_per_request(config, ...) × group.page_size_bytes` | | `kv_cache_interface.py` | | +177 / −889 lines | Overall, production code changes 113 files, +2388 / −3157 lines. No compat shims: out-of-tree specs and platform-registered managers need updating. ## Validation - CPU unit tests (`CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=`), run on this branch and on its base `df6c7ad031`: ``` pytest tests/v1/core tests/v1/kv_connector/unit tests/v1/worker -q --timeout=120 \ --ignore=tests/v1/core/test_scheduler_e2e.py --ignore=tests/v1/core/test_reset_prefix_cache_e2e.py ``` Branch: 3540 passed / 313 failed / 125 errors (base: 3543 / 313 / 126). Every failing test ID also fails on the base (GPU, NCCL or world-size requirements), apart from renamed tests whose old names fail the same way. Tests in `tests/v1/{engine,spec_decode,attention,simple_kv_offload,kv_offload}` and the model and kernel tests touched here pass or fail for device reasons only. `pre-commit` (ruff, mypy) passes. - **Pending:** GPU unit tests, and E2E serving/eval on hybrid SWA, Mamba hybrid, DSv4/GLM packed, HiSparse and P/D connectors. ## Details - **Grouping:** one rule replaces the planner's "identical spec" and "uniform type" paths. `MambaManager` additionally requires equal page sizes. Page-size unification, padding and group splitting are unchanged. - **Behavior changes:** - Same-policy layers with different layouts can now share a group. - Builders that need policy declare `requires_kv_cache_manager_config` (Mamba, GDN, linear attention, KDA, QSA, Dots3). - Encoder-only attention is a manager policy, which lifts its one-spec limit. - **Hazard reviewed:** collapsing policy subclasses into `AttentionSpec`/`MLAAttentionSpec` broadens any `isinstance` check that really meant a policy. All such checks were audited, and the ones that meant policy now test the manager: - the coordinator's cache-hit batching key now includes `dcp_sharded` - the Mooncake store's TP-sharded layout gate - the HiSparse MLA filter - **Out of scope:** planning still runs in the engine core. Backend-declared configs and worker-driven allocation are later parts of #42449. - **Not a duplicate:** open PRs were searched for #42449, `UniformTypeKVCacheSpecs`, `KVCacheSpecRegistry`, `manager_config` and `KVCacheTensorSpec`. ---
Pull Request Checklist - [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
